name: chiron
description: A library of agent skills. The one it's named for installs a portable ideaVerse — an Obsidian-style knowledge vault, the tooling that keeps it honest, and the skills that use it — into any repo, and upgrades it in place. The rest need no vault.

plugins.name: chiron
plugins.description: Install, adopt, upgrade or verify a chiron ideaVerse in any repo — the ACE vault, the aiOS operating layer, a compiled concept wiki, and the vault skills. Shows a plan before it writes, and never overwrites a file you edited.

plugins.name: chiron-productivity
plugins.description: Grilling: a relentless one-question-at-a-time interview that stress-tests a plan or design before you build it. Works in any repo, with or without an ideaVerse.
